# J. Perry & Sons

> Licensed Florida general contractor (CGC1540699) delivering luxury kitchen, bathroom, tile, stone and whole home renovations across South Florida.

## What this company is

A single licensed general contractor that handles the whole renovation, from the first walkthrough to the final review. Thirteen services sit under one license, so one company answers for the entire job instead of coordinating separate trades.

## What makes it different

Every project starts with a written scope: the work planned, the material selections involved and a budget range, reviewed with the owner before construction begins. When something changes mid-build, the change is documented and priced before work continues.

Fourteen of the thirty-four service areas are gated communities and private country clubs, including St. Andrews, Mizner, Woodfield, Stonebridge and Seagate. Association approval, certificates of insurance, delivery windows and permitted work hours are handled before the first crew arrives.

## What it is not

Not a design firm, not a handyman service, and not a national franchise. It does not sell renovation packages online and does not quote a price without seeing the property.

## Who it is for

Owners of high-end homes and commercial spaces in Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties, Florida, who are planning a renovation and want the scope and the budget settled in writing before demolition.

## Services

Kitchen renovation, bathroom and spa, tile installation, flooring, stone slab and countertops, epoxy flooring, painting, pavers and hardscaping, custom closets, fireplace installation, stone veneer, commercial renovation, full home renovation.

## Service area

Miami-Dade County, Broward County and Palm Beach County, Florida. Cities include Miami, Brickell, Coral Gables, Aventura, Doral, Pinecrest, Fort Lauderdale, Weston, Parkland, Pompano Beach, Pembroke Pines, Coral Springs, Boca Raton, West Palm Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, Wellington, Delray Beach and Boynton Beach.

## Credentials

Florida General Contractor License CGC1540699.
